title: Connectors
description: Connect your tools, databases and MCP servers: actions for agents, syncs into knowledge and events for workflows.

catalog.demoHint: No OAuth app configured: a demo connection will be created. Variables: {vars}

connections.emptyHint: Pick a connector from the catalog to connect your first tool.
connections.disconnectDescription: The connection, its credentials and its syncs are deleted. Files and tables already synced stay in knowledge.
connections.oauthError: The connection could not be completed ({code}).
connections.demoMissing: Sample data. To connect the real account set {vars}.

connect.title: Connect {name}
connect.name: Connection name
connect.oauthIntro: We will redirect you to {name} to authorize access. Messer stores tokens encrypted and refreshes them automatically.
connect.demoBody: This provider's OAuth app is not configured. A demo connection with sample data will be created so you can try actions, syncs and events.
connect.readOnlyNote: Queries are read-only by default: Messer uses read-only transactions and blocks any write statement.
connect.readOnlyHint: Turn it off only if agents must be able to write (every write requires approval).
connect.useAgentHint: The connection string is configured on the agent and never leaves your network.

detail.eventsHint: Use them as a workflow trigger (“Connector event” type).
detail.demoBody: It uses sample data from a fictitious company. Set {vars} and reconnect to use the real account.

actions.sideEffectHint: Changes data or sends something outside Messer: agents need approval to use it.
actions.confirmDescription: This action has external effects (sends, creates or changes data in {connector}).
actions.invalidJson: The arguments are not valid JSON

syncs.emptyHint: Sync folders, pages, objects or tables into a knowledge base.
syncs.notSupported: This connector does not sync into knowledge.
syncs.modeHint: Full rereads everything and removes what no longer exists; incremental only fetches changes since the last run.
syncs.cursorFieldHint: Column that increases when a row changes (e.g. updated_at).
syncs.primaryKeyHint: Columns identifying each row; changes are merged on it.
syncs.scheduleHint: Cron expression in UTC (at most every 5 minutes).
syncs.targetTableHint: Optional: table name in the knowledge base.
syncs.deleteDescription: It will stop syncing. Files and tables already imported are kept.

webhook.howToBody: Sign the request body with HMAC-SHA256 and the secret, and send the signature in the {header} header as sha256=HEX. Optionally add {timestamp} (Unix seconds) and sign “timestamp.body” to prevent replays.
webhook.howToToken: Send the secret in the X-Messer-Token header or the token URL parameter.
webhook.rotateDescription: The current secret stops working immediately. You will need to update it in the sending system.

agents.title: On-prem agents
agents.description: A lightweight binary on your network opens an outbound connection to Messer: read-only queries, introspection and file copies without exposing your databases.
agents.name: Name
agents.emptyHint: Enroll an agent to connect databases and folders on your network without opening ports.
agents.deleteDescription: It is disconnected immediately and its connections stop working.
agents.enrollIntro: Run one of these commands on the machine in your network. The token is single-use and expires in 24 hours; it will not be shown again.
agents.configIntro: Declare the data sources and the allowed folders. Connection strings stay on the agent.
